player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mutambi {player_id} muConnect Four.
Chishongo chako: {symbol}.
Bhodi ya mutambo ina {num_rows} safu na {num_cols} mitsamba.
Vatambi vanotamba zvekutamba vachidhibiti chishongo chavo mukati me mitsamba (0 kusvika {end_col}).
Anenge atamba ari wekutanga kubatanidza (ake) diski nne wakati achipinda, achipfuura, kana ari diagonal anohwinha.
Pavakutamba kwako, nyora nambari ye mitsamba mabhuku e makoronyera kutamba.
Sekuruza: '[col 4]' kana '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mwari {player_id}, Furmata ya action isingafanane. Inofanira kuwa na furmata: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mwari {player_id}, Action isingafanane. Koloni {col} iri kunze kwenyu miganhu.

action.dropped_disk: Mwari {player_id} akabvisa disk yake ({player_symbol}) kwenyu koloni {col}.
